text: Replace pointwise BCE with within-user Bayesian Personalized Ranking: for each training user, sample one long_view-positive and one negative impression, optimize softplus(-(score_positive-score_negative)) with the existing ID-sum scorer, and retain the same validation early stopping and fixed primary metric.
rationale: This directly targets GAUC and nDCG@5 while preserving the additive architecture and bounded sampled-pair cost. Compare primary first, then inspect GAUC, nDCG@5, MAP@5, MRR@5, HitRate@5, classification metrics, and score distribution diagnostics for ranking gains or collapse.
